# captured from: generacy --version 0.0.1
Usage: generacy cockpit queue [options] <epic-ref> <phase>

Queue every eligible ref under a phase heading to the cluster pipeline.

Arguments:
  epic-ref             Epic ref (owner/repo#N).
  phase                Phase token — matched case-insensitively against the
                       first token of a ### heading.

Options:
  --label <name>       Workflow label (default: process:speckit-feature).
  --repo <owner/repo>  Restrict the invocation to a single repo.
  --assignee <login>   Override the default cluster-account assignee.
  --yes                Skip the interactive confirmation prompt.
  -h, --help           display help for command
